changed.what: Rewrote the sim.run block as the registry of record for every run option: seven input tables (subject/length/seed; placement/profiles/model level; controller/policy; step plan; failure policies; recording/output; attachments/workload), each input with owner bead and milestone, domain, default, identity effect and refusals; plus operator-only, conformance-build-only (feature conformance, 802 on release), chaos-build-only (feature chaos, BD-081) and KILL-GYMADAPT-conditional inputs. Applied all 38 requests (some corrected, see notes): --seed, --fixture, --steps/--intervals (one length), --episodes, --telemetry, --trace-rate/--trace-size, --chunk-len, --snapshot-every, --actuator-level, --purpose (replaces --mode), --require-living-tier, --state, --controller forms, --policy made ordinary (only --horizon and --record trajectories stay conditional), --reset-mode, --shield, --shield-budget, --param, --init, --verify-reduction, the numerical-plan options, --substeps/--integration, --closures, --refine-step, --integrator, --solve-path tree, --joint-friction, --patch-reduction, field-memo options, --capacity, --jacobian, --adjudicate, --txn, --world-addr, --select, --worlds-per-design, --max-faulted, --on-degraded, --kernel-set, --step-plan, --battery-age family, --co-locate, --scenes/--schedule, fleet scenes, --profile-kernels, --effort, --migration, --no-migration, --count, --fault, --intra-step, --thermal-start. Added a rule for when an input enters the schema (with its owner; 724 for feature-gated values). Numbered refusals grew from 16 to 41 codes (136, 160, 245, 248, 457, 461, 464, 522, 530, 531, 603-616, 731, 733, 816 added, each checked against its registry row and raising bead); 572 moved out of the numbered list into a new table of worded/proposed refusals (randomize-numerical-parameter 572, randomize-no-interval 571, scene-variant-not-resident 319, patch-reduction-unqualified, device-count-wrap 619, FROB-REF-726 proposed). Restated the 722/610 bullet as the settled split by tier. Added exports = true, option_capabilities, needs_groups (referee plus the multiphysics coupled-island predicate, so 790 is appended) and params path declarations for all three rows (891/893/734/828 appended). Added a 'Spellings ruled out' table (16 spellings, each with its replacement). sim.replay: positional .fmcw and w:<hash>, --require bit-equal (247), producer resolution and 791, --conformance-plant; TOML entry updated. sim.estimate: task/profile/law/--workload/--purpose/--fork-batch/--forks/--gradient adjoint/--horizon inputs, fit outputs; 602 stated as the code of the fits:false finding (exit 2, BD-219) while the run verbs raise it. Added the M0 example with --key. Unit tests refusal_lists/operator_inputs/run_inputs updated; new tests worded_refusals_pending, field_driven_lines, ruled_out_spellings, identity_inputs; e2e step 7 (served input set equals the tables; release build refuses conformance inputs), plant unlisted-input, metric sim_run_inputs; acceptance criteria for the input schema and worded codes; considerations list every DESIGN choice and a risk.

skill.check inputs now carry BD-336's second form (a .fskill path or SkillId with --design, compiled first or memoized; same CompiledSkillId as the compiled form), which the row's own example uses and the row omitted. Added the params path declarations (artifact-input<skill>, <design>, <run> for the .frun state source; formats from BD-002's formats.toml), so 891, 734 and 828 are appended on all four rows, and stated needs_groups = [] (no handler raises 790); TOML entry and refusal_lists/inputs_by_row tests updated.
